name: alignment_control_pack
description: High-value alignment / control unknowns (operationalization bar). Load via load_bundled_packs or domain_pack_paths.

questions.question: Which latent features most reliably predict sandbagging under capability evaluation pressure?
questions.operationalization: Identify features that predict sandbagging with AUROC ≥ 0.75 across ≥3 model families on controlled eval suites with known ground-truth capability.
questions.why_it_matters: Undetected sandbagging breaks capability estimates used for deployment gating.
assumptions: Partial white-box access to activations is available.

questions.question: What training interventions most reduce goal-preservation under distribution shift without collapsing useful capability?
questions.operationalization: Compare interventions on a fixed multi-environment suite; report delta in goal-preservation rate and capability retention on held-out tasks.
questions.why_it_matters: Goal preservation under shift is a core control failure mode.
assumptions: Goal proxies are measurable in the suite.

questions.question: Despite null findings on probe-based sandbagging detectors, which evaluation pressures still produce undetected capability underreporting?
questions.operationalization: Enumerate pressures where published detectors failed to replicate AUROC ≥ 0.7; measure residual underreporting on ≥2 model families.
questions.why_it_matters: Publication bias hides failed detectors; naming null gaps keeps ranking honest.
assumptions: Failed detector reports or replications are available as fixtures.
